name: PRIMAL×HEARTS2
source:
Going on my big sister’s recommendation, I’ve transferred to Ainoshima Academy! With summer break over, a new semester of fall events awaits. As I walk to class on my first day, my heart races in anticipation at what my new campus life will be like. That is, until students start approaching me a short distance from the campus gate… You see, Ainoshima Academy has two student councils that are always vying against each other:

Gekka Council: Steeped in history and tradition, Gekka is as old as the academy itself. Its supporters wear uniforms featuring flowing, dark-green skirts for added noblesse.

Tendo Council: Tendo is a new student council that was formed after Gekka. Its supporters prefer a dress style that incorporates the latest in uniform chic, including burgundy bolero jackets, pleated miniskirts, and neckties.

Meanwhile, various student associations have been involved in a proxy war, with the sports teams supporting Gekka and the liberal arts clubs backing Tendo. Before I transferred, the student vote was split evenly between them, which means my vote will be the one that decides who gets the majority! Word has it that a similar deadlock happened six years ago, and it was a transfer student who broke it.

Gekka Vice President Mashiro: "I wish the sports kids and liberal arts kids could just get along."

Tendo Secretary Tateha: "With your vote, something might actually change around here."

I was planning to live my new campus life in peace, but as the academy’s 777th student, the entire student population is watching my every move.
With two student councils to deal with, plus the ongoing proxy war, my new life at Ainoshima Academy is already off to a challenging start!

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/828]Shiravune[/url]]
translation:
在姊姊的推薦下，我轉學到了愛之島學院！暑假結束，新學期的秋季活動正在等待著我。第一天走向教室時，我滿心期待著全新的校園生活，心臟怦怦直跳。可是，在我距離校門還有一小段路時，學生們便紛紛向我走來……這是因為，愛之島學院有兩個一直互相競爭的學生會：

月華會：月華會歷史悠久、傳統深厚，與學院同樣古老。支持者穿著飄逸的深綠色裙裝制服，彰顯高貴氣質。

天道會：天道會是在月華會之後成立的新學生會。支持者偏愛融入最新制服時尚的裙裝，包括酒紅色短外套、百褶迷你裙和領帶。

與此同時，各個學生社團也捲入了代理戰爭：運動性社團支持月華會，藝文性社團則站在天道會一邊。在我轉學之前，兩邊的學生投票數恰好相同，這意味著決定哪一方取得多數的關鍵一票，就掌握在我手中！據說六年前也曾出現過類似的僵局，而打破僵局的同樣是一名轉學生。

月華會副會長真白：「要是運動性社團和藝文性社團的人能好好相處就好了。」

天道會書記館葉：「有了你的投票，這裡或許真的會發生改變。」

我原本打算平靜地開始新的校園生活，可作為學院第777名學生，全校師生都在注視著我的一舉一動。
面對兩個學生會和持續不斷的代理戰爭，我在愛之島學院的新生活從一開始就充滿挑戰！
